Q01.drivers: Slim, ordinary proportions; normal waist and hip transitions; straight legs

Q02.drivers: Large protruding belly and soft chest in front view; very deep, rounded trunk in profile; thick thighs; limbs otherwise human

Q04.drivers: Slim, slightly long legs, otherwise ordinary

Q07.drivers: Somewhat fuller hips/buttock and deeper chest in profile, but within ordinary range

Q09.drivers: Profile shows a strongly forward-bulging keel-like chest over a sharply pinched waist and small pelvis/buttock; trunk segment shape unlike human chest; pronounced bulging calf with thin knee; thin arms relative to chest depth
axial_cues: very deep barrel/keel chest in profile
limb_cues: narrow knee with strongly bulging calf

Q10.drivers: Stockier trunk with deep belly/buttock in profile, broad shoulders; leg ratio similar to others; within ordinary heavier-set range (borderline B bulk)
axial_cues: deep abdomen and buttock in profile

Q11.drivers: Same pattern as Q09: very deep forward-projecting chest in profile, pinched waist, small pelvis, bulging calves with narrow knees; arms slender

Q12.drivers: Very wide, rectangular slab-like trunk with almost no waist and flat front/back planes in profile; thick columnar legs; arms comparatively thin. Reads as extreme bulk/heavy build like Q02, but the boxy planar structure (no belly sag) could indicate a distinct stocky race
axial_cues: flat front and back planes in profile

distinguishing_features: Only one group (Q09, Q11) clearly reads as non-human: deep forward keel chest, pinched waist, small pelvis, bulging calves. If Q12 (and possibly Q02) were a distinct stocky race, they would be easy to tell apart from Q09/Q11: a boxy rectangular trunk with no waist and columnar legs, versus a keel chest over a wasp waist. I am not confident Q12 is non-human, though.
